qa.q: Do you like talking to people?
qa.a: I love a good natter, doesn't everyone? Especially if it's about something I'm into, or if people have lots of questions about something I can help them out with. I suppose there has to be some sort of constructive point to it, but generally, yes, I do like talking to people.

qa.q: Do you like being around other people?
qa.a: Usually, particularly if they're, I don't know, competent or interesting to be around. I doubt anyone's thrilled by being with those who complain about, well, everything and don't hold out any chance of finding a solution. It's just a waste of time, and it sort of sucks the energy out of the room, doesn't it?

qa.q: Would you prefer to stay alone or with other people?
qa.a: Well, that's contingent on what I'm doing. Um, if I have an essay to write, then I prefer to be by myself. However, I'll be the first to admit that it's better if other people are around in general. You can share ideas and have a good time, and you probably get more done.

qa.q: Do you like to spend time with friends?
qa.a: Oh, doesn't everyone? I don't see the point in having friends if you don't want to hang out with them. Even if it's online, you would ideally still want to be around them. I mean, I can't think of any other circumstance when you would want to have friends unless it was um, well, I don't know, to to exploit them for some sort of purpose, but then they're not really your friends, are they?

qa.q: What do you and your friends do together?
qa.a: Typically for Scotland, and if it's a weekend, then we pretty much head out to a bar or a club. If it's a school night, I suppose it's comparatively tame and we'd sit and watch movies and reminisce and tell jokes and anecdotes.

qa.q: Do you remember a time when you needed to cooperate with others?
qa.a: Well, I have to cooperate with people all the time, since we live in a society. Though if you want a specific instance, then my tutor group at university collaborates on when to have meetings and how to structure our ideas and tasks every week.
